valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E per ADR, price-only. Reported in EUR; 1 ADR = 1 ordinary share (ratio 1:1 per SAP investor relations ADR page; depositary Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas per SAP 20-F FY2024). EUR converted at USD 1.1052 per EUR (ECB euro reference rate for 13 Nov 2026, Banca d'Italia publication). Model: FY2027 non-IFRS operating profit x 0.75 (tax and financial items; calibrated to Q3 2026 net income EUR 2,269m / non-IFRS operating profit EUR 3,030m = 0.75) = net income; / diluted shares (Q3 2026 diluted 1,157m, reduced for the EUR 10bn buyback through 2027 of which EUR 4.2bn was done by 30 Sep 2026) = EUR EPS per ADR; x 1.1052 = USD EPS per ADR; x P/E applied to FY2027 EPS at the Nov-2027 target date. Dividends excluded.

bear.driver: Cloud deceleration from slow agentic-AI rollout (UBS thesis): FY2027 non-IFRS operating profit EUR 12.3bn, roughly +2.5% on the FY2026 guide midpoint of EUR 12.0bn; buyback slows
bear.assumption: EPS EUR 8.24 = USD 9.10 per ADR at 20x; 1,120m shares

base.driver: FY2026 guide held (cloud revenue upper end of EUR 25.8-26.2bn cc; non-IFRS operating profit EUR 11.8-12.2bn) and carried forward to EUR 13.5bn in FY2027 (+12.5%)
base.assumption: EPS EUR 9.08 = USD 10.04 per ADR at 25x; 1,115m shares

bull.driver: Current cloud backlog (EUR 24.1bn, +26% cc at Q3) converts faster; non-IFRS operating profit EUR 14.5bn in FY2027 (+21%)
bull.assumption: EPS EUR 9.80 = USD 10.83 per ADR at 28x; 1,110m shares

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of USD 10.04 the close of USD 234.9 (EUR 212.6) implies 23.4x. The provider's published mean target of USD 284.5 implies 28.3x base EPS, or about USD 11.38 EPS (EUR 10.30, roughly 13% above the model) at 25x. The mean of the three dated named targets (USD 270.4) implies about 26.9x, about two turns above the base multiple.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by USD 10.04 (4.3 pp of the close). EUR 1bn of FY2027 non-IFRS operating profit moves EPS about EUR 0.67 and the base target about USD 19 at 25x (about 8 pp of the close)
valuation.watch_metric: Current cloud backlog growth (Q3 2026: +26% cc, guided to slightly decelerate) and cloud revenue growth into FY2027; base case needs non-IFRS operating profit near EUR 13.5bn, i.e. roughly 12-13% growth on the FY2026 guide midpoint
valuation.next_disclosure: FY2026 results and FY2027 outlook, scheduled for 28 Jan 2027 per secondary calendar sources (not verified against SAP's own calendar); Q1 2027 results in April 2027

analyst_notes: Named coverage is thin: three dated, named calls (JPMorgan upgrade to Overweight, target EUR 175 to 275, published 10 Nov; Goldman Sachs Buy, EUR 230 to 258, 23 Oct; UBS downgrade to Neutral with target EUR 164 to 201, 26 Aug). Kepler (EUR 235, 26 Oct), Jefferies (EUR 250, 22 Oct), Barclays (EUR 250, undated), Bank of America (EUR 226) and Berenberg (EUR 205) lack a verifiable analyst name or date and are excluded from events. The three named targets average USD 270, about 8% above the USD 251 base case; the gap is the market paying for a faster AI-led cloud ramp than the base case assumes. None of the named horizons is documented as 12 months, so all targets stay out of the weighted consensus.
